Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-01-12T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: Staggered close playbook — initial GDoc + timing suggestions

Hi Elena / Tom,

Thanks again for the time yesterday. I promised to share a simple, staggered close playbook we use for regulated customers that want a phased evaluation + production ramp. Attached is the editable MAP template (Word) and I've seeded a short GDoc that lays out a 3-stage timeline (POC -> Pilot -> Production) with acceptance gates.

Key things I seeded for Pharmex:
- 30-day POC acceptance criteria (latency, cost-per-token estimate, sample inference throughput)
- 60-day pilot with SOC2 evidence and private deployment checklist
- Go/no-go decision points and procurement triggers

Action items I propose:
1) Review the GDoc and drop comments on acceptance criteria by next Wed (2026-01-14).
2) Marissa will coordinate a 60-minute tech validation session the week of Jan 19.
3) Ben and I will prepare a staggered commercial term (trial credits -> committed pilot pricing -> Dedicated contract) and share redlineable terms.

GDoc link: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1a2B3cPlaybookDraft
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/9834

Attaching: redwood_map_template_v1.docx (editable), sample evaluation checklist (Excel).

Thanks — happy to iterate.

—
Hiro Tanaka
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
hiro@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Elena Morales <elena@pharmex.com>

Date: 2026-01-13T08:07:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Staggered close playbook — initial GDoc + timing suggestions

Hi Hiro — really useful start, thank you. Tom and I reviewed the draft and added comments directly in the GDoc. A couple of quick notes:

- Acceptance criteria: can you add an explicit SLA for 95th percentile latency at our target sequence length? We need that for architecture sign-off.
- Security: please add a mandatory SOC2 evidence bundle step before the pilot kickoff (we can't start pilot without the report).
- Commercial: the pilot needs a clear consumption cap and cost-protection clause. We will ask procurement for a one-time PO for the pilot (approx $12k).

I attached our eval criteria workbook (pharmex-eval-criteria.xlsx) with stakeholder priorities.

We can do the tech validation Jan 20 or Jan 22 — Tom prefers the 20th.

Thanks,
Elena
Director, AI Platforms | Pharmex
elena@pharmex.com | +1 (617) 222-4444
